versions.changelog: Remove runtime auto-install of nh3; declare nh3 in dependency list and setup.sh with pinned version; remove all sandbox-related strings from code and docs

Security hardening: remove sudo/npm -g/hardcoded sandbox flags; add HTML sanitization (XSS prevention); fix task list checkbox rendering; fix misleading CDN-free description; npm deps now install to local vendor dir
Added bilingual hard rules: no auto-split without user request; prefer PDF for long content
Fix: code block even-row text invisible (tr:nth-child(even) bg override in code-table)

**Summary:**  
v0.3.0 introduces multi-format output, more robust offline rendering, and advanced features for Markdown-to-image conversion in messaging apps.

- Now supports exporting as JPEG, PNG, WebP, or PDF.
- Adds 4 color themes: light, dark, sepia, and nord.
- Introduces smart page splitting (A4, A5, or none).
- Fully offline rendering with zero CDN dependency.
- Enhances syntax highlighting, LaTeX rendering, Mermaid diagrams, and task lists.
- Expanded and improved CLI options for rendering and sending.
